actions.action: Trim or pick out dead brown stems at the base
Bottom-water in a tray or bowl for 15–20 minutes, then drain
Check soil every few days and water when the top feels dry
Empty any water collecting in the decorative bowl
Move plant to the brightest window
Alternatively set up an LED grow light on a 12–14 hour timer
Repot if it becomes root-bound or the soil stays soggy

reason: Dry soil is listed as one of several causes and bottom watering is suggested, but only briefly. The answer misses the undrained pot and poor soil, and its advice to hold off on repotting delays the repot into a draining container that fixed the plant.
